name: Hyper Japan
blurb: The UK's biggest Japanese culture festival, held at Olympia London and covering anime, manga, music, fashion, food and gaming.
notes: The homepage only advertises the Festival edition that already ran 24-26 July 2026 (Olympia London) — before the 2026-10-05 research window — and gives no 2027 dates; the ticket link is for that past July 2026 show. The seed note's claim that Hyper Japan 'runs twice yearly (summer Festival + winter Christmas Market)' is outdated: per Wikipedia, the winter Christmas Market last ran in November 2018 and was not revived; a one-off Manchester expansion ran November 2025, but that is a different city and nothing on hyperjapan.co.uk announces a 2026 repeat of it or a 2027 London Festival date. Left editions empty rather than guess; cover uses the current 'HJF26' og banner, the only official key art live on the site. 2026-10-05 fixup pass: homepage re-checked fresh, still only the past July 2026 Festival; recorded it as "last" (venue confirmed as "Olympia Events, Hammersmith Road, London W14 8UX" i.e. Olympia London).
